learning_outcomes.text: To provide engineering candidates with essential management knowledge necessary for their careers (private sector, public sector, NGOs...).
To equip students with management techniques that will make themselves and their teams efficient.
To assist in their personal development.
To enrich students' competencies required for teamwork composed of individuals from different disciplines.
Consequently, to increase the competitiveness of engineering candidates in today's competitive business world.

assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
